scope.temporal_cloud: O5; isolates integral error without acquiring extra hidden references
scope.temporal_reason: eight consecutive central-trajectory frames around fixed representative30, moving occluder plus handheld camera; no selection by scores

modes.analytic1: full uniform-disk second-moment Gaussian covarianceR^2/4 plus determinant-area opacity compensation
modes.analytic4: four disjoint aperture-quadrant area centroids and within-quadrant covariance; no repeated fullCoC; diagnostic-only because Gaussian replacements and residual Cfill integration are not exact
modes.fixed64: original deterministic antithetic golden-angle64, primary comparator, not GT
modes.random16: independently seeded uniform disk per frame, diagnostic-only

regions.in_focus: known visible GT depth and absCoC<=1
regions.out_of_focus: known visible GT depth and absCoC>=2
regions.band: visible depth discontinuity3% relative inverse-depth, union1.5x max localCoC footprint; no hiddenGT selection
regions.recoverable: existing independent aperture GT actual13input recoverable total, residuals excluded

metrics.PSNR: float64 pooled SSE/(3pixels) within scene/focus/mode/cloud, report absolute Cycles PSNR and each aperture
metrics.LPIPS_pool: fixed whole unmasked64patches, weighted by region pixels
metrics.RGB: same standard display sRGBfloat[0,1];3D integrates true linearRGB

noise.unseen_frame60_rule: use maximum of corresponding lens probe pair; not a confidence interval
noise.tie: abs LPIPS change <=3 times corresponding independent-pair regional noise; tie is not directional improvement
noise.recoverable_region_noise: use band noise as contextual narrow-band proxy; report this limitation
noise.control: B2-low descriptive only, noise calibration not certified for formal low decisions

noninferiority.absolute_quality: report actual Cycles PSNR/LPIPS of every mode including fixed64; no extra score threshold inferred fromK64

efficiency.timing: GPU synchronized rendering only, identical Gaussian cloud, cameras/resolution, no cloudbuild or diskIO; JIT warmup excluded

temporal.metric: RMSE of predicted RGB frame-difference minus CyclesRGB frame-difference, unaligned

artifact_stop.primary_cases: B2-high f1.4/2, at least two distinct frame/focus configurations
artifact_stop.scope: systematic partial-occlusion leakage/halo/sorting, after mathematical/unit/raster correctness checks; if triggered report before temporal/L2 expansion

implementation.analytic_raster: Triton inference-only gsplat-compatible depth sorted alpha;alpha threshold1e-6 to avoid dense-CoC components being discarded by native1/255 cutoff

decision: if unacceptable systematic artifacts occur, stop and report before L2/L3; simple failure of0.2dB noninferiority alone is not the stop condition
